description: Deploy a checksum-verified GitHub release to the existing Nextou stack

runCommand:
set -eu
umask 077
release="/opt/nextou/releases/$SSM_ReleaseId"
install -d -m 700 "$release"
aws s3 cp "s3://nextou-deployment-622308589716-ap-south-1/github-releases/$SSM_ReleaseId/release.tar.gz" "$release/release.tar.gz" --region ap-south-1 --only-show-errors
printf '%s  %s
' "$SSM_Checksum" "$release/release.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
python3 - "$release" <<'PYCODE'
import sys, tarfile
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(sys.argv[1])
expected = {'deploy.py', 'release.json', 'backend.tar.gz', 'frontend.tar.gz', 'recommendation.tar.gz'}
with tarfile.open(root / 'release.tar.gz', 'r:gz') as archive:
    members = archive.getmembers()
    if {m.name for m in members} != expected or len(members) != len(expected) or not all(m.isfile() for m in members):
        raise ValueError('Unexpected release archive contents')
    archive.extractall(root)
PYCODE
python3 "$release/deploy.py" "$release"
